title: Sharplink button
description: Square 34px buttons in narrow uppercase type, made of a label box and a separate square arrow box 2px away. The main one is a solid box with a blue arrow box that slides across to the left on hover while the label shifts right (0.5s, easeInOutCirc); tinted ones deepen from 10% to 18% fill in 0.25s.
notes: solid uses foreground / background, so it reads light on dark sections and dark on light ones
renders an <a> when given href, otherwise a <button>
name: sharplink-button

props.name: href
props.description: a link target; without it the button is a <button>

props.name: variant
props.description:
solid: a solid foreground box with a primary (blue) arrow box that slides to the left on hover.
tint: a 10% foreground tint that deepens to 18% on hover.

props.name: arrow
props.description: show the separate square arrow box (always on for solid)

props.name: icon
props.description: the icon in the arrow box (an arrow by default)

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: stretch to the full width of the parent, label centred ("mobile": only below the lg breakpoint)
